biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend actually opens a NEW Atlantic Union Bank checking account AND completes the qualifying activity themselves (personal: qualifying direct deposits totaling $500+ within 60 days of account opening). A friend who opens but never sets up direct deposit earns you nothing.
catches: Referred friend must open their first new eligible AUB personal checking account within 90 days of receiving the referral and receive qualifying direct deposits totaling $500+ within 60 days of account opening (business referral: $1,000+ average balance over first two statement periods).
Referrer capped at $500 in referral bonuses per calendar year (5 qualifying referrals).
Bonus deposited 4-6 weeks after all conditions are met; both accounts must be open and in good standing at payout.
Bonus reported to the IRS as interest on Form 1099-INT; recipient responsible for taxes. Valid US Taxpayer ID (W-9) required; nonresident aliens (W-8) excluded.
Only one referrer may earn per referred person (first to enter their info). Referral email/text may be lost if the referred person opted out of AUB marketing.
Offer may be revoked, restricted, or changed at any time at AUB's discretion.

steps: Register and accept terms at the AUB Referral Center (AtlanticUnionBank.RoyalReferralCenter.com).
Submit a valid email address and phone number for yourself and each friend you refer.
Your friend opens their first new eligible AUB personal checking account within 90 days of receiving the referral.

Your friend receives qualifying direct deposits totaling $500+ within 60 days of account opening (or, for a business referral, maintains a $1,000+ average balance over the first two statement periods).
The $100 cash bonus is deposited to your AUB checking account 4-6 weeks after all conditions are met.
timing: Bonus directly deposited to the referrer's AUB checking account 4-6 weeks after all conditions have been met; accounts must be open and in good standing at payout.
when_cash_arrives: Bonus directly deposited to the referrer's AUB checking account 4-6 weeks after all conditions have been met; accounts must be open and in good standing at payout. The payout clock starts when your friend finishes qualifying, and the reward arrives as a mailed (or emailed) Reward Card 4-6 weeks later.
maximize: Start the clock ASAP: the 4-6-week card window only begins after your friend completes every requirement - have them qualify in the first days of the window, not the last.
Front-load the friend's activity (debit transactions, direct deposit) so verification does not push delivery past 6 weeks.
Watch for a redemption email - some ReferLive programs issue virtual cards faster than physical mail.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: payout is a Reward Card with a 4-6-week delivery window baked into the terms - qualification speed is the only lever.
